title: 1997 South Korean presidential election
displaytitle: 1997 South Korean presidential election

titles.display: 1997 South Korean presidential election

extract: Presidential elections were held in South Korea on 18 December 1997. The result was a victory for opposition candidate Kim Dae-jung, who won with 40% of the vote. When he took office in 1998, it marked the first time in Korean history that the ruling party peacefully transferred power to the opposition party.
